products.name: Microsoft 365 Security Baseline & Audit Readiness (Secure Score / Compliance Manager) — Commercial
products.short_description: A repeatable Microsoft 365 security baseline and audit-readiness program — harden the tenant to a documented baseline (improving Secure Score), map controls to frameworks with Compliance Manager, and maintain control evidence. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Harden the Microsoft 365 tenant to a real baseline — and walk into the audit with evidence in hand

Most Microsoft 365 tenants are configured to 'it works', not 'it's secure' — and when an audit or a framework assessment lands, nobody can show the controls are in place. This solution delivers a repeatable Microsoft 365 security baseline and audit-readiness program: harden the tenant and services to a documented baseline (improving Secure Score), map controls to recognized frameworks with Compliance Manager, and maintain the control evidence so audit readiness is continuous, not a fire drill.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the M365 secure-configuration baseline (identity, email, collaboration, device, data services), Microsoft Secure Score, Compliance Manager and control mapping to recognized frameworks, and the control-evidence model.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Microsoft 365 + relevant security/compliance licensing, Entra ID, the target framework(s), a baseline owner, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: assess current Secure Score and configuration, apply the secure-configuration baseline across services, map controls in Compliance Manager to the framework, capture control evidence, validate, then maintain on a review cadence.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — M365 secure-config + Secure Score discovery, baseline-compliance validation, a Secure Score + control-evidence report, safe remediation of baseline gaps, and a baseline-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A Microsoft 365 tenant hardened to a documented baseline with an improving Secure Score, controls mapped to your framework, and evidence maintained — so audits are a report, not a fire drill, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • M365SEC-Discovery.ps1 — Microsoft 365 secure-configuration readiness: Secure Score + key service config (Graph)
    • M365SEC-Remediation.ps1 — safe remediation of baseline gaps (defaults to -WhatIf)
    • M365SEC-Report.ps1 — Secure Score + control-evidence report for the audit evidence pack (Graph)
    • M365SEC-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create the baseline scope Entra groups (pilot / broad)
    • M365SEC-Validation.ps1 — baseline compliance: does the tenant match the baseline register? (Graph)

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
